Unresolved information

  • resolved Cs2CO3 mass/amount basis
  • pressure during either degassing hold
  • stirring rate and heating ramps
  • numerical injection/quench delay
  • N2 flow rate
  • first wash absolute solvent volume
  • final toluene volume and concentration
  • storage temperature/duration
  • run identifier and replicate count
  • sample-specific atomic coordinates/CIF
  • Table 1 particle-size metric and statistical meaning of +/-1.4 nm

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • 16 mg Cs2CO3 corresponds to about 0.049 mmol formula units (about 0.098 mmol Cs atoms), whereas 0.1 mmol formula units would be about 32.6 mg. Source does not specify a Cs-atom basis for the parenthesis. Preserve both printed values and leave the basis unresolved; do not silently choose a correction.
  • Figure 1e axis and methods say solvodynamic diameter, whereas caption says radius. Do not use that DLS axis as an unambiguous alternative particle-size label without separate review.
  • Paper identifies orthorhombic phase but uses cubic facet nomenclature for convenience. This is not evidence of cubic crystal phase.
